gloss: to pull up; to raise; to withdraw

definitions.gloss: to pull up; to lift up
definitions.explanation: To physically pull or lift something upward.
To increase prices, standards, or levels.
To pull back from a location, especially military forces or operations.

examples.japanese: {溺|おぼ}れた{人|ひと}を{水|みず}から{引|ひ}き{上|あ}げた。
examples.english: I pulled the drowning person out of the water.

examples.japanese: {会社|かいしゃ}は{価格|かかく}を{引|ひ}き{上|あ}げた。
{軍|ぐん}は{前線|ぜんせん}から{引|ひ}き{上|あ}げた。
examples.english: The army withdrew from the front line.

notes:
COMPOUND VERB:
{引|ひ}く (to pull) + {上|あ}げる (to raise)

TRANSITIVITY:
{他動詞|たどうし} (transitive) - takes を
Intransitive pair: {引|ひ}き{上|あ}がる

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {価格|かかく}を{引|ひ}き{上|あ}げる: to raise prices
- {水準|すいじゅん}を{引|ひ}き{上|あ}げる: to raise standards
- {税金|ぜいきん}を{引|ひ}き{上|あ}げる: to raise taxes
- {水|みず}から{引|ひ}き{上|あ}げる: to pull out of water

CONTRAST:
- {引|ひ}き{下|さ}げる: to lower, reduce
